captures.description: THE CERTIFICATION, SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-01: 'The Authors Guild Human Authored Certification is a credential and seal verifying that a book's text was written entirely by a human rather than generated by artificial intelligence.' Core rules and scope (allowed AI uses, exclusions, a cap of 10 titles a year); requirements and pricing (members free, 'Identity is verified upon joining'; non-members $10 a title and third-party verification 'such as Veriff'; a binding license per title); mark usage and the public database; an offer on non-member accounts and 'collaborative multi-author works'. Five cards: three Authors Guild pages, Jane Friedman, Publishers Weekly.

atoms.evidence: Human Authored is an Authors Guild certification mark
is a credential and seal verifying that a book's text was written entirely by a human rather than generated by artificial intelligence.

Non-Members: $10 per title. Requires a third-party identity verification service (such as Veriff).
All issued credentials receive a unique registration number
